title: Accept only loopback listeners and same-site host authority
preconditions: The local review server can be started on loopback and probed with controlled Host, Origin, and fetch-site headers.

steps.action: Attempt to start the reviewer on non-loopback addresses.
steps.expected_result: Startup fails before the application advertises or serves a URL.

steps.action: Send foreign Host, Origin, and cross-site requests to a loopback listener.
steps.expected_result: Each request is rejected before the target handler runs.

steps.action: Send requests using the actual loopback address or localhost with same-origin context.
steps.expected_result: The origin gate accepts the request and the intended handler owns the response.

expected_result: Pass when only loopback serving and valid local authority are accepted; fail if a remote listener, foreign host, or cross-site request reaches an application handler.
